name: golfapp-tests
description: Regression tests for GolfApp's money-critical golf logic, plus behavioral tests for the Firebase security rules. Node's built-in test runner (node:test) handles all the golf-logic tests with zero dependencies, matching the app itself. The one exception is `targaryen` (devDependency), a small pure-JS Firebase Realtime Database rules simulator used only by tests/security-rules.test.js — needed because security rules require real behavioral evaluation, not just reading the file. Run `npm install` once before `npm test`.
